## DataQ — current state (2026-07-24)

**Shipped:** v1.0.0 tagged 2026-07-04, deployed and live on Azure Container Apps. Working tree clean on `main` at `1d83463d`.

**Cycle:** v1.1 (2026-07-04 → 08-15, + W7 stretch to 08-22).

| Week | Status |
|---|---|
| W1 — Snowflake close-out + PATs | ✅ closed |
| W2 — portability (OTel logs, secrets lifecycle, dry-run depth) | ✅ closed 14/14 |
| W3 — Azure wind-down + local-first | ✅ closed 2026-07-19, 23/23 |
| W4 — `schema_drift` + flat-file monitors + DQ dimensions | ✅ closed 2026-07-19, 8/8 |
| **W5 — `anomaly` kind + metric trends (due 08-08)** | **0/8 — current, not started** |
| W6 — scale-aware execution + hardening + cycle close (08-15) | 0/14 |
| W7 — stretch backlog burn-down (08-22) | 0/10 |

**Last work landed (W4, deployed + live-verified 2026-07-19):** ADR 0038 DQ-dimension classification (#945), shared `services/rollup.py` (#948), asset DQ scorecard (#950), flat-file CSV delimiter sniffing (#934) + flat-file freshness/volume incl. arrival-time (#940), dialect-quoted monitor SQL (#937), dimension backfill (#952), and a live-only UC freshness fix (#953 — the Databricks driver returns MAX(timestamp) as a `str`; no fixture could catch it).

**W5 next up:** [#593](https://github.com/TheurgicDuke771/DataQ/issues/593) anomaly kind (rolling z-score over `metric_value`, `skip` on cold start) + [#594](https://github.com/TheurgicDuke771/DataQ/issues/594) trend view, plus a results/connections UX batch (#345/#283/#351/#424/#349) and #568 threshold-ordering validation.

**Two things worth your attention now:**
1. **Azure wind-down was planned for ~2026-07-25 — that's tomorrow.** The subscription is PayAsYouGo with no spending limit, so awake resources are billing real money.
2. [#954](https://github.com/TheurgicDuke771/DataQ/issues/954) — two prod Snowflake PATs are dead, and a *datasource* connection with a dead credential shows no visible state until a run fails (#839's health signal only covers orchestration connections).

No blockers otherwise; all open items are follow-ups scheduled into W5–W7.

content.text:
Triaged all 12 open PRs (all Dependabot, opened 2026-07-20) and all 6 open CodeQL alerts.

## Open PRs — 8 mergeable now, 4 blocked

**✅ Green, safe to merge (8):**

| PR | Bump |
|---|---|
| #967 | `@fontsource/inter` 5.2.8 → 5.3.0 |
| #965 | `typescript-eslint` 8.63 → 8.64 |
| #964 | `@eslint/js` 9.39.4 → 9.39.5 |
| #963 | `snowflake-connector-python` 4.6.0 → 4.7.1 |
| #962 | `snowflake-sqlalchemy` 1.10.2 → 1.11.0 |
| #961 | `@types/node` 26.0.0 → 26.1.1 |
| #957 | `actions/setup-python` 6 → 7 |
| #956 | `actions/setup-node` 6 → 7 |

(#957's only non-success is `deploy=SKIPPED`, which is correct — deploy is `workflow_dispatch`.)

**🔴 Blocked — each needs a human commit, none is a retry-and-it-passes:**

- **#958 `fastapi` 0.138.2→0.139.2** and **#959 `fastmcp` 3.4.3→3.4.4** — both fail `Backend — lint & format` with `ERROR: drift between backend/requirements-typecheck.txt and .pre-commit-config.yaml mypy hook deps`. Dependabot only edits [requirements.txt](backend/requirements.txt); the same pins are re-listed at [requirements-typecheck.txt:16](backend/requirements-typecheck.txt#L16) / [:18](backend/requirements-typecheck.txt#L18) and [.pre-commit-config.yaml:25](.pre-commit-config.yaml#L25) / [:27](.pre-commit-config.yaml#L27). Fix = a two-line fixup commit on each branch mirroring the version. This is structural: **every** Dependabot bump of a typecheck-listed package will fail this way.

- **#960 `opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http` 1.43.0→1.44.0** — `ResolutionImpossible`. The exporter is pinned alongside `opentelemetry-sdk==1.43.0` ([requirements.txt:40-44](backend/requirements.txt#L40-L44)) and 1.44.0 requires SDK 1.44. Needs a coordinated bump of `opentelemetry-sdk` + the two `opentelemetry-instrumentation-*` `0.64b0` pins together. The pip-audit job burned 4 retries on it because the retry loop treats install failure as a transient PyPI 5xx — it isn't.

- **#966 `monaco-editor` 0.55.1→0.56.0** — **a real breaking change, not a flake.** 618 tests pass; the suite fails to even load because `monaco-editor/esm/vs/editor/editor.worker?worker` no longer resolves — 0.56 changed the worker entry path. [SqlEditorField.tsx:3](frontend/src/components/checks/SqlEditorField.tsx#L3) needs updating to the new subpath, and since this is the Monaco custom-SQL editor (ADR 0019), it wants a live check in the browser, not just green CI.

**Systemic fix worth one PR:** `.github/dependabot.yml` has **no `groups:` config** — that's why the OTel bump arrived alone and un-mergeable. Adding an `opentelemetry` group (and one for the frontend dev-tooling churn) would collapse most of this recurring noise.

## CodeQL — 6 open, all `note`, zero with a security severity

| # | Rule | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 61 | `py/unused-global-variable` — `COMPARISON_KIND` | **False positive.** It's imported and used in 8 modules ([check_service.py:72](backend/app/services/check_service.py#L72), [run_service.py:141](backend/app/services/run_service.py#L141), `comparison_run.py`, `suite_io_service.py`, `runs.py`). The query only sees module-local reads. Dismiss as *false positive*. |
| 52, 53, 57, 58 | `py/cyclic-import` in `backend/app/lineage/` | **By design.** [warehouse.py:170-184](backend/app/lineage/warehouse.py#L170-L184) lazy-imports the two providers inside `get_warehouse_lineage_provider()` specifically so the module stays free of the SQLAlchemy-heavy impls — the docstring says so. The cycle never exists at import time. Dismiss as *won't fix*, with that note. |
| 56 | `py/unnecessary-lambda` in [test_warehouse_lineage_task.py:60](backend/tests/worker/test_warehouse_lineage_task.py#L60) | **Real but cosmetic**, in test code. One-line cleanup or dismiss. |

Also open: **1 Dependabot alert** — `dompurify` `CUSTOM_ELEMENT_HANDLING` bypass, severity **low**, no fix PR raised.

**Suggested order:** merge the 8 green ones → one PR that adds Dependabot groups + fixes the typecheck-sync drift for #958/#959 → handle the OTel group bump → treat #966 as a small task with a browser check. Want me to start on any of these? The dismissals need to go through the GitHub API, which changes repo state, so I'll ask before firing those.

Merge all 8, then make the necessary changes to the other 4.

I'll work through this in order. Let me set up tracking and start merging.
